别名

  • Saimin BRAIN MACHINE INTERFACE

あらすじ

A guy buys something called the Brain Machine Interface at the convenience store. It claims to be software that can connect human and machine intelligence.

Essentially, if the human brain can be programmed, it can be hacked, or rather, hypnotized. The guy naturally uses this marvel of technology to get revenge on a rude high school girl.
